name: BSP_MissionTreeScreen_FindMissionByName
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this, pair<uint,uint>* out, const string* name) returning out, RET 8. name: BSP_MissionTreeScreen_Construct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(this) returning this, SEH frame, RET. The 34h screen at 00E198AC+5Ch, the smallest of the seven. Chains BSP_FrontEndScreen_Construct (004F7180), installs primary vtable 00CF170C at +00h and 00CF16F8 at +08h, and zeroes +18h..+30h. Slot +00h of 00CF170C is 005CA8E0, a 'mov eax,2; ret' leaf, so the screen id is 2 = INTF_MISSIONTREE. Its register override 005CAAF0 reads Scripts/datatables/MissionTree.lua through the keys multiMissionInfos and missionGroups and reports progress through BSP_LoadingScreen_ReportProgress; there is no GUI layout in the class, so this holds the mission-tree data rather than a page. See docs/MAIN_MENU_SCREENS.md.

name: BSP_MissionTreeScreen_Register
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(this), RET, SEH frame, 9C0h of stack. Slot +10h of vtable 00CF170C. Chains BSP_FrontEndScreen_Register (004F71D0), then reads Scripts/datatables/MissionTree.lua through the keys multiMissionInfos and missionGroups, reporting progress with BSP_LoadingScreen_ReportProgress once per entry of the first loop. The first loop push_backs 34h-byte group entries into the vector at +14h (proxy) / +18h / +1Ch / +20h; the second push_backs 434h-byte mission records into the vector at +24h..+30h. The tail calls 005C3470 with a name from 00586150 and stores the pair into +0Ch (mission index) and +10h (group index), clamping a negative mission index to (0, 0). See docs/MISSION_TREE_BRIEFING_SCREENS.md.
